description: Get variable definitions for a given node id. E.g. {'icon/default/secondary': #949494}. Variables and styles are reusable values applied to colours, fonts, sizes and spacings. Values resolve for the node's own mode. Read-only; with no nodeId it uses the selection. Use it for design tokens, and get_design_context for the layout. Without the plugin, a saved snapshot gives the raw values only, without names.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file. Accepted for compatibility; the file open in Figma Desktop is always used.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node, eg. "123:456" or "123-456" (instance ids like "I1:2;3:4" work too). Omit it to use the current selection in Figma.

name: get_variable_defs
title: Get Variable Definitions
